newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends unchanged due to Central Bk.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends unchanged due to Central Bk.

text.p: The Philippine peso was anchored at the same level of 26.322 in Wednesday's last deal as the Central Bank dominated dollar purchases, traders said.
Large inflows came in which banks believe were the proceeds of the Europeso note launched on Monday by the International Finance Corp.
These bloated market volume to $274.30 million from $118 million.
Dealers estimated the Central Bank bought about $75 million to $82 million at 26.321 and 26.322.
"Fundamentally, the dollar should be strong because interest rates are going down," a dealer said. "Either stay square or not too short on the dollar."
A second dealer said the peso may have already reached its ceiling at 26.32 and it may just trade siwdeways from 26.32/26.328 as the Central Bank limits its movement.
On Thursday, the peso is not likely to weaken from a $20.4-million requirement of oil firms, dealers said. Banks sold $10.4 million to oil firms on Wednesday.
